accepted.title: The last sparkler box

options.text: Pretend I don't care at all and look away
options.consequence: You walk off, but your stomach stays in knots for the rest of the evening.

options.text: Shout loudly so all the neighbors stare at him
options.consequence: Yash turns red, hides the box behind his back, and refuses to talk to you.

options.consequence: Ishita nods, and the two of you practise the exchange until the timing clicks.

options.text: Complain that Ishita ran too fast so the coach doesn't blame me
